public_rationale: ARC Prize reported a 75.7% score for o3's high-efficiency configuration on the ARC-AGI-1 semi-private evaluation set on December 20, 2024 [e2]. Its April 22, 2025 report said released o3 frequently failed to return outputs at high reasoning, and those runs were excluded from the leaderboard for insufficient coverage [e1]. These execution failures support the narrow claim that released o3 at high reasoning could not readily reproduce the December result during April release-period testing [e1, e2].
limitations: Incomplete coverage does not establish o3-high's full-set accuracy or an inherent capability ceiling [e1].
December's high-efficiency configuration and April's high-reasoning setting are not established as identical configurations [e1, e2].
These reports do not establish reproducibility on other December benchmarks or performance after the April 1–23, 2025 target period [e1, e2].
